items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well Thomas Jefferson took over the band when Bill Matthews left, you see.

ctx.x: Yeah, well he's good too. Yeah. Yeah, well I remember I rehearsed with them when they had the band called the Crescent City High Hours, a bunch of youngsters around his age. I'd sit in with them several occasions on the rehearsals, you know.
Well Thomas Jefferson took over the band when Bill Matthews left, you see. Oh yeah. And he's in on trumpet now and he's got a trumpet with him.
Who do Bill Matthews play with now?
